guidedBy: Ebumnuche na-eduzi anyị, ọmịiko na-akpali anyị, anyị kwenyesiri ike na mgbanwe
weFocusOn: Anyị na-elekwasị anya n'akụkụ anọ bụ isi iji mee mgbanwe na-adịgide adịgide na obodo
youthEmpowermentDescription: Inye ndị ntorobịa nkà, ihe ọmụma na ohere maka ọdịnihu na-arụpụta ihe.
humanitarianDescription: Inye nkwado ozugbo na nke ogologo oge nye ndị mmadụ na ezinụlọ ndị na-adịghị ike.
sustainableDescription: Imepụta ngwọta na-adịgide adịgide site na atụmatụ na mmekọrịta obodo na-eduzi.
advocacyDescription: Ịbawanye mmata maka okwu ndị dị mkpa na-emetụta ndị mmadụ na-adịghị ike.
buildingSustainable: Iwuli mmetụta na-adịgide adịgide site na atụmatụ atụmatụ a na-elekwasị anya
communityEngagementDescription: Ịrụ ọrụ ozugbo na obodo iji chọpụta mkpa na imepụta ngwọta ọnụ.
capacityBuildingDescription: Ime ka ọgbakọ na ndị mmadụ n'obodo sikwuo ike ibute mmepe nke ha.
partnershipDevelopmentDescription: Iwuli mmekọrịta atụmatụ na gọọmentị, ụlọ ọrụ nzuzo na ọha mmadụ.
innovationResearchDescription: Iji ụzọ data na-akwado iji bulie mmetụta na ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma.
joinUsDescription: Ọnụ, anyị nwere ike iweghachi olileanya ma gbanwee ndụ n'ofe Nigeria.
